title: Omar Bernard's band and joining the Tuxedo band
summary: After his first band he played with trumpeter Omar Bernard, then joined the Tuxedo band with Ridgley and Celestin on Tio's recommendation, got his first alto sax, and left to marry.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone

blocks.x: Did you have a name for that band? Huh? Did you have any name for that band?
Yeah! After that, I started playing with Paul Villar. Not Paul Villar. With Omar Bernard. Omar Bernard, he is dead. The old trumpet player.
What was the name of the band? Huh? What was the name of the band? It was named after him. Omar Bernard. Omar Bernard's band.

It was named after him. Bernard after him. After him, I left him and joined the Tuxedo band. I joined the Tuxedo band with Ridgely and Celestin at that time. Tio is the one that recommended me to join the band. I played with them for about two, three years. I quit them until I quit to get married. Because they was going too regular for me.
What did you play in the Tuxedo band? I was playing Clannett.

I was playing Clannett, yeah. I was playing Clannett. And no, right before I left, they bought the saxophone. Oh, you got saxophone too. They bought the saxophone for me. Yeah. Yeah, they bought the saxophone for me. And I started playing my saxophone with them.
Was that tennis sax sax? Alto.
